currentWork.title: FINAL.32 natural highway preference + live navigation — validated, ready for production
currentWork.releaseStatus: PR #162 clean product head 75832390bfd0d4c2c5995121dc11597d35e4d524 is validated. Clean Preview dpl_9wcgk6rMFy8NL1QKRxEXGZBFs6Kw is READY and the temporary smoke endpoint is removed.
rootCause: FINAL.31 preferred any motorway/toll candidate but did not distinguish a short expressway segment from a naturally longer expressway route.
Navigation geometry remained static after route creation, so already-travelled segments stayed visible.
GPS movement did not automatically request a new route after sustained departure from the remaining geometry.
scope: Highway ON ranks eligible HGV alternatives by actual motorway/toll distance, not only boolean presence.
Alternative search is widened to target_count=3, share_factor=0.95, weight_factor=2.0.
Natural-detour guard rejects expressway candidates more than +35% travel time capped at +15 minutes, or +50% distance capped at +20 km, versus the provider primary route.
Route summary shows approximate selected highway/toll distance.
Accurate GPS fixes advance monotonic route progress and already-travelled geometry is removed from the displayed route line.
Three consecutive accurate off-route fixes beyond the adaptive threshold trigger automatic recalculation from the current position, with a 30-second reroute cooldown.
GPS fixes worse than 50m accuracy do not advance route progress or trigger rerouting.
Automatic reroute failure retains the previous route instead of clearing guidance.
FINAL.31 MAP highway toggle, FINAL.29 road classification/colors, fullscreen PIN behavior, HGV profile restrictions, Analytics, DB/schema, tasks, orders, visits and user data remain unchanged.
